scripts.test:db:up: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile test up -d --wait postgres-test
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait postgres mailpit
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter api exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: pnpm --filter api exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: pnpm --filter api exec prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: pnpm --filter api exec prisma migrate reset --force && pnpm db:seed
